items.q: Yeah. I caught him at a party, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. I caught him at a party, you know. I never could figure out where he was... Well, maybe he might have been something, I don't know. He was just... The only one that I got to really like was Baby James. This cat had a nice sound and he played those things of Louis nice, you know. I don't know whatever happened to him.
What was it you didn't like about the others?
